column5: An agent plans and routes a question to vector search or SQL, a grader checks whether the results are relevant and sufficient, and the agent retries until it can give a grounded answer with citations.
Hybrid retrieval returns about 100 candidates for recall, a cross-encoder scores each query-passage pair, and only the top 5 reach the LLM.
A planner LLM asks the retriever which team owns payments, gets Team Atlas back, substitutes it into a second query for the manager, and answers citing both chunks.

GraphRAG indexing turns chunks into an LLM-extracted entity graph, groups it into Leiden communities with summaries, and queries run either local search over the graph or global map-reduce over the summaries.

A router sends document questions to vector and keyword RAG and data questions through schema retrieval, LLM-written SQL, validation and execution as the user, and the LLM answers from the rows with the SQL shown.

Source changes flow through a change queue and a content-hash check into re-embedding and a gap-free upsert into the search index, with cache invalidation, nightly reconciliation of orphans and a p95 lag SLA.

A router scatters the query to compressed HNSW shards, merges their candidates, rescores at full precision and reranks with a cross-encoder before the LLM, alongside the memory arithmetic for 50M chunks.
A query matches a small child chunk inside Section 4.2, and the whole parent section is returned to the LLM as context.
The RAG service resolves the user's groups from the identity provider, queries the index with a tenant and ACL pre-filter so only permitted chunks return, and prompts the LLM with those chunks only.
An index version moves from Building to Evaluating on the golden set, then to Live behind an alias or to Discarded, and the previous Live index is kept for rollback.
In QLoRA, frozen NF4 weights are dequantized block by block to bf16 to compute W x, a trainable bf16 LoRA adapter computes B A x, and the two are summed into the bf16 output.
Seed prompts go to a teacher model, outputs pass verification, deduplication and a human spot-check, and the survivors are mixed with real data for training, with four ways to generate shown below.

An expert eval set and a prompt-plus-RAG baseline reveal the gap type: language leads to continued pre-training, behavior to SFT and preference tuning, and changing facts to retrieval, ending in eval and compliance review.
Constitutional AI first fine-tunes on answers the model critiqued and revised against its principles, then an AI judge labels answer pairs for a preference model that drives RL on the policy.
Two GPUs each hold a column slice of A and a row slice of B, compute a partial output locally, and one all-reduce sums the partials into the replicated output Y.

Inference replicas export load metrics to Prometheus, KEDA or HPA sets the replica count, and the cluster autoscaler adds GPU nodes, scaling on queue, in-flight and KV-cache signals rather than CPU or GPU utilization.
Requests are classified, costed in tokens and admitted or rejected with a 429, and admitted work waits in weighted fair queues (70/25/5) before the engine batches and preempts it.
Synchronous inference holds the connection open and streams tokens back, while asynchronous inference returns a job id at once and delivers the result later by webhook or polling.
